name: Illustration
summary: Drawn art, inline: an SVG whose colours come from five role classes (`ink`, `muted`, `fill`, `surface`, `accent`) on tokens, so one file follows light, dark and more contrast; whose groups marked `data-size` show by the illustration's own width; and whose parts marked `data-motion` (`float`, `pulse`, `draw`, `fade`, `spin`) move on the motion tokens. For photos and art that can't follow tokens, use `Image`.
a11y: With `label` it is `role="img"` with that name; with `decorative` it is hidden from screen readers. The art itself is never focusable. Motion stops under reduced motion (the resting frame); a loop always has a visible Pause control (WCAG 2.2.2) and stops off screen.

props.name: children
props.description: The art written in code: one `<svg>` with a `viewBox`, its shapes coloured by the role classes.

props.name: src
props.description: A same-origin `.svg` file (or one per size), fetched and cleaned before it's drawn inline.

props.name: dark
props.description: A file for the dark scheme, only for art that can't follow the role classes (MP17's rule: same shape).

props.name: ratio
props.description: The frame's shape. `natural` (default) takes the art's own `viewBox`; give a ratio for a file, so its space is held before it arrives.

props.name: fit
props.description: How the art meets the frame: `contain` (default) shows all of it; `cover` fills the frame and trims the overflow.

props.name: play
props.description: When parts marked `data-motion` move: `once` (default) the first time it comes into view; `hover` while it, or the link, button or card around it, is pointed at or focused; `loop` while in view, always with a Pause control. Under reduced motion nothing moves and every part holds its resting frame.

props.name: label
props.description: What the illustration shows, for one that carries meaning (`role="img"`).
